name: Cello
author: Versilian Studios (Sam Gossner) / packaged for DAW
attribution: VS Chamber Orchestra: Community Edition (VSCO-2 CE) by Versilian Studios (Sam Gossner, Simon Dalzell; sample cutting by Elan Hickler/Soundemote). CC0 1.0.
desc: Cello section, sustained arco with vibrato, 2 velocity layers (soft/loud), looped. MIDI 36-80. Warm bass lines, sustained harmony, melodic lines in the tenor range. | Playable MIDI 33-81 (A1-A5), 2 velocity layers crossfaded. Params: human 0-1 (timing/level/pitch life), velcurve (velocity response), keytrack/bright (tone follows pitch/velocity). Articulations: params.artic 0=arco (sustain), 1=staccato, 2=pizzicato, 3=tremolo, 4=marcato (accented); load presets "Pizzicato"/"Staccato"/"Tremolo"/"Marcato". Legato melody: overlap consecutive notes by ~30 ms (next note starts before the previous ends) with glide 0.03-0.06; wide leaps crossfade naturally (legato=1), legato=0 = pure slide.
